title: PocketTSLM: Deploying an On-Device Soft-Prompt Time-Series Language Model for Privacy-Preserving Smartphone Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21308v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Consumer phones and wearables increasingly collect physiological time-series data, yet most mobile systems treat these streams as summaries or text rather than as temporal evidence. This representation is poorly matched to personal health systems that need to retrieve, route, or summarize sensor evidence while preserving temporal structure. Cloud-hosted time-series language models avoid smartphone limits, but they repeatedly move sensitive physiology off the device and add latency and per-query compute cost. Mobile model alternatives that aggregate time-series data into statistical features or serialize raw samples as text either compress temporal structure or exhaust the context and memory budgets of small on-device models. We present PocketTSLM, a mobile-native deployment of OpenTSLM SoftPrompt, the soft-prompt variant of the OpenTSLM time-series language model. translated_title: PocketTSLM：部署设备端软提示时间序列语言模型以实现隐私保护的智能手机推理
translated_abstract: 消费级手机和可穿戴设备日益收集生理时间序列数据，然而大多数移动系统将这些数据流视为摘要或文本，而非时间证据。这种表示方式与个人健康系统的需求匹配不佳，后者需要在保留时间结构的同时检索、路由或汇总传感器证据。云端托管的时间序列语言模型虽然避开了智能手机的限制，但它们会反复将敏感的生理数据传出设备，并增加延迟和每次查询的计算成本。而将时间序列数据聚合为统计特征或将原始样本序列化为文本的移动模型替代方案，要么压缩了时间结构，要么耗尽了小型设备端模型的上下文和内存预算。我们提出了PocketTSLM，这是OpenTSLM SoftPrompt（OpenTSLM时间序列语言模型的软提示变体）的移动原生部署方案。PocketTSLM通过注入编码的时间……（摘要截断），完全在消费级智能手机上运行。
tldr: 提出PocketTSLM，一个完全在消费级智能手机上运行的设备端软提示时间序列语言模型移动原生部署方案，在保留时间序列结构的同时实现隐私保护的生理数据推理。
en_tdlr: PocketTSLM is a mobile-native on-device deployment of the OpenTSLM SoftPrompt time-series language model that runs fully on consumer smartphones, enabling privacy-preserving reasoning over physiological time-series data while preserving temporal structure.
